title: Harden OrderFlow egress: deny unlisted outbound internet traffic
label: orderflow-fault
body:
Demo fault (synthetic). Adds an explicit outbound deny so the OrderFlow apps subnet only reaches the documented Container Apps egress allowlist.

This pull request is a predefined OrderFlow GitOps demo fault created by the presenter lifecycle. It changes only `scenarios/orderflow/gitops/deploy/network-rules.json` and passes the offline rule check. Merge only during a live demo with an owned environment.

properties.description: Enforce documented Container Apps egress allowlist
